svg.title: Compare Retained Dollars per Completed Assignment
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-service-rail-retained-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Retained Dollars per Completed Assignment; subtitle: Five service examples use the same 45% retained-share assumption.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Synthetic pricing examples, not fee schedules or market quotes. Each bar measures USD retained before pod overhead for one completed one-way trip or one defined courier run. Assignment duration and mileage differ, so bars do not rank hourly returns.; caption: Apply the contracted unit definition before comparing yield; a courier run and a passenger trip are not interchangeable units.; stages: label: Medicaid broker ambulatory trip; value: $31.50 retained from a $70 completed one-way trip; numeric value: 31.5; detail: $70 gross less $38.50 driver settlement leaves $31.50. Use broker authorization and trip-log rules; disputed eligibility or missing GPS evidence can erase collection.; label: Medicaid broker wheelchair trip; value: $54 retained from a $120 completed one-way trip; numeric value: 54.0; detail: $120 gross less $66 driver settlement leaves $54. Verify vehicle equipment, securement capability, passenger assistance requirements, and the authorized transport level.; label: Workers'-comp administrator trip; value: $45 retained from a $100 completed one-way trip; numeric value: 45.0; detail: $100 gross less $55 driver settlement leaves $45. Confirm administrator authorization and contracted wait-time rules rather than importing Medicaid billing assumptions.; label: Scheduled laboratory courier run; value: $40.50 retained from a $90 defined collection run; numeric value: 40.5; detail: $90 gross less $49.50 driver settlement leaves $40.50. Specify included stops, receiving cutoffs, packaging responsibility, and custody-event evidence in the route scope.; label: Contracted STAT specimen run; value: $81 retained from a $180 defined urgent run; numeric value: 81.0; detail: $180 gross less $99 driver settlement leaves $81. Price backup availability and deadline exposure; higher dollars per run do not establish better utilization.

rect.title: label: Medicaid broker ambulatory trip; value: $31.50 retained from a $70 completed one-way trip; numeric value: 31.5; detail: $70 gross less $38.50 driver settlement leaves $31.50. Use broker authorization and trip-log rules; disputed eligibility or missing GPS evidence can erase collection.

label: Medicaid broker wheelchair trip; value: $54 retained from a $120 completed one-way trip; numeric value: 54.0; detail: $120 gross less $66 driver settlement leaves $54. Verify vehicle equipment, securement capability, passenger assistance requirements, and the authorized transport level.

label: Workers'-comp administrator trip; value: $45 retained from a $100 completed one-way trip; numeric value: 45.0; detail: $100 gross less $55 driver settlement leaves $45. Confirm administrator authorization and contracted wait-time rules rather than importing Medicaid billing assumptions.

label: Scheduled laboratory courier run; value: $40.50 retained from a $90 defined collection run; numeric value: 40.5; detail: $90 gross less $49.50 driver settlement leaves $40.50. Specify included stops, receiving cutoffs, packaging responsibility, and custody-event evidence in the route scope.

label: Contracted STAT specimen run; value: $81 retained from a $180 defined urgent run; numeric value: 81.0; detail: $180 gross less $99 driver settlement leaves $81. Price backup availability and deadline exposure; higher dollars per run do not establish better utilization.

text.title: Assumptions: Synthetic pricing examples, not fee schedules or market quotes. Each bar measures USD retained before pod overhead for one completed one-way trip or one defined courier run. Assignment duration and mileage differ, so bars do not rank hourly returns.
